<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Chainsaw"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Properties" name="Chainsaw properties" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Update" name="Production update" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FirstSaw" name="First saw delivered" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer feedback" />

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_Producer" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Order" messageRef="Message_Properties" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Update" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Update" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FirstSaw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_Feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Chainsaw production" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Order" name="Chainsaw properties received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>F1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Properties" messageRef="Message_Properties" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from online sources">
      <bpmn:incoming>F1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false" />
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PartsArrived" name="Parts arrived">
      <bpmn:incoming>F2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Inspect" name="Inspect all parts manually">
      <bpmn:incoming>F3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AssemblyMerge" name="Assembly step">
      <bpmn:incoming>F4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>F9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Assemble" name="Assemble saw">
      <bpmn:incoming>F5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdate" name="Send production update to customer" messageRef="Message_Update">
      <bpmn:incoming>F6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SawComplete" name="First saw complete?" default="F9">
      <bpmn:incoming>F7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstSaw" name="Send first saw to customer" messageRef="Message_FirstSaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>F8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Feedback" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:incoming>F10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Likes" name="Customer likes first saw?" default="F13">
      <bpmn:incoming>F11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRest" name="Produce rest of order">
      <bpmn:incoming>F12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotProduced" name="Rest of order not produced">
      <bpmn:incoming>F13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderFulfilled" name="Order fulfilled">
      <bpmn:incoming>F14</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Order" targetRef="Task_OrderParts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Event_PartsArrived" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="Event_PartsArrived" targetRef="Task_Inspect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="Task_Inspect" targetRef="Gateway_AssemblyMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="Gateway_AssemblyMerge" targetRef="Task_Assemble" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="Task_Assemble" targetRef="Task_SendUpdate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_SawComplete" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="Gateway_SawComplete" targetRef="Task_SendFirstSaw">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${firstSawComplete == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F9" sourceRef="Gateway_SawComplete" targetRef="Gateway_AssemblyMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F10" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Event_Feedback" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F11" sourceRef="Event_Feedback" targetRef="Gateway_Likes" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F12" sourceRef="Gateway_Likes" targetRef="Task_ProduceRest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${customerLikesFirstSaw == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F13" sourceRef="Gateway_Likes" targetRef="End_NotProduced" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F14" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRest" targetRef="End_OrderFulfilled" />

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description joins two activities with 'and' (for example, one party performs both actions for the same case) and gives no stated order between them, so both must be completed before the flow continues: Model the two activities as parallel branches: place a parallel gateway split before them and a parallel gateway join after them, so the next step starts only when both branches have completed. Do not model them as a sequence with an arbitrary order, and do not model them as alternatives.
rules.situation: the description states that, after a preceding step, one activity is carried out in parallel for several items (for example, marked with an explicit '(in parallel)' note), and a later step depends on all of those items being obtained

rules.instruction: When the description states that a step is carried out by people physically handling items (for example assembling or inspecting them) and names no software or system that performs or supports the work: Model that step as a bpmn:manualTask, not as a bpmn:serviceTask (which is reserved for automated service work) or a bpmn:userTask (which requires software assistance). Keep the step as a separate activity when the description describes it separately.
rules.situation: the description states that a step is carried out by people physically handling items (for example assembling or inspecting them) and names no software or system that performs or supports the work

rules.instruction: When the description says an external party (such as a customer) has provided information, and the producer then performs a distinct step that works on that information (for example determining, specifying or preparing items from it): Model the arrival of the information as an event (a message start event or an intermediate catch event, as the description implies), and keep the producer's subsequent step as its own activity placed after that event. Use a userTask or manualTask according to whether the description states software support. Do not let the receipt event replace the step that works on the information.
rules.situation: the description says an external party (such as a customer) has provided information, and the producer then performs a distinct step that works on that information (for example determining, specifying or preparing items from it)

rules.instruction: When the description says that a group of activities may be carried out in parallel, starting from one point and leading to a later step that needs all of them finished: Open the group of parallel activities with a parallel gateway split placed after the point where they may start, give each activity its own outgoing branch from that split, and close the branches with a parallel gateway join before the later step. Do not sequence the activities one after another, and do not add decision conditions to these branches.
rules.situation: the description says that a group of activities may be carried out in parallel, starting from one point and leading to a later step that needs all of them finished
